blocks.zh: 時間限制與無菌製程確效
blocks.en: Time Limitations and Aseptic Process Validation

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 說明 21 CFR 211.111 對無菌製程各階段時間限制的要求，並理解為何需要數據支持每一項時間限制
blocks.en: Explain the requirements of 21 CFR 211.111 for time limits at each stage of aseptic processing, and understand why every time limit must be supported by data

blocks.zh: 描述培養基模擬填充 (Media Fill / Process Simulation) 的設計要素、頻率、持續時間與規模，以及最差情境設計的重要性
blocks.en: Describe the design elements, frequency, duration, and size of a media fill (process simulation), and the importance of a worst-case design

blocks.zh: 解釋培養基模擬填充結果判讀標準，並正確應用不同規模批次（<5,000 / 5,000–10,000 / >10,000）的汙染單位接受準則
blocks.en: Explain the criteria for interpreting media fill results, and correctly apply the contaminated-unit acceptance criteria for different batch sizes (<5,000 / 5,000–10,000 / >10,000)

blocks.zh: 說明過濾效能確效 (Filtration Efficacy Validation) 的關鍵要素，包括挑戰菌株選擇、挑戰濃度與完整性測試要求
blocks.en: Explain the key elements of filtration efficacy validation, including challenge organism selection, challenge concentration, and integrity testing requirements

blocks.zh: 列舉滅菌確效 (Sterilization Validation) 的技術要素，包括空腔研究、熱穿透研究、生物指示劑使用，及 SAL 10⁻⁶ 要求
blocks.en: List the technical elements of sterilization validation, including cavity (empty-chamber) studies, heat penetration studies, use of biological indicators, and the SAL of 10⁻⁶ requirement

blocks.zh: 將上述確效概念連結至 CDMO/COO 的實際操作脈絡，識別常見稽核風險點
blocks.en: Link these validation concepts to day-to-day CDMO/COO operations and identify common audit risk points

blocks.zh: Section VIII — Time Limitations 時間限制 (pp. 20–21)
blocks.en: Section VIII — Time Limitations (pp. 20–21)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何需要時間限制？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Are Time Limits Needed?

blocks.zh: 無菌製程的每一個階段都涉及微生物污染的動態風險。時間越長，潛在的生物負荷累積、 內毒素增長、或過濾膜穿透風險就越大。21 CFR 211.111 要求廠商對每個生產階段 建立有數據支持的時間限制，而不是憑經驗猜測。
blocks.en: Every stage of an aseptic process carries a dynamic risk of microbial contamination. The longer the time, the greater the potential accumulation of bioburden, growth of endotoxin, or risk of microorganisms penetrating the filter membrane. 21 CFR 211.111 requires firms to establish data-supported time limits for each production phase, rather than guessing from experience.

blocks.zh: 需要建立時間限制的關鍵階段包括：
blocks.en: The key stages that need time limits include:

blocks.zh: 配製（Compounding）開始 → 過濾滅菌：防止生物負荷過度累積
blocks.en: Start of compounding → sterile filtration: prevents excessive bioburden accumulation

blocks.zh: 過濾滅菌 → 填充完成：防止已滅菌液體再污染
blocks.en: Sterile filtration → completion of filling: prevents recontamination of the sterilized liquid

blocks.zh: 滅菌設備/容器/塞子 → 使用：防止滅菌後再污染或生物膜形成
blocks.en: Sterilized equipment/containers/stoppers → use: prevents post-sterilization recontamination or biofilm formation

blocks.zh: 生產線上的產品暴露時間：控制環境暴露風險
blocks.en: Product exposure time on the production line: controls the risk from environmental exposure

blocks.zh: 注意：時間限制需數據支持，不是「查 SOP 上面寫的」
blocks.en: Note: time limits must be supported by data, not just "what the SOP says"

blocks.zh: FDA 要求時間限制由生物負荷 (bioburden) 和內毒素負荷 (endotoxin load) 的實際數據來支持。常見的稽核缺失是：廠商的時間限制來自「業界慣例」或「以前一直這樣做」， 而無法出示時程研究 (hold time study) 數據。
blocks.en: FDA expects time limits to be supported by actual bioburden and endotoxin load data. A common audit finding is that a firm's time limits come from "industry practice" or "we have always done it this way", and the firm cannot produce hold time study data.

blocks.zh: 如果超出建立的時間限制，必須文件化記錄 + 科學論證不影響品質， 不能只是填寫偏差報告了事。
blocks.en: If an established time limit is exceeded, there must be documented records plus a scientific justification that quality is not affected; simply filing a deviation report is not enough.

blocks.zh: 類比：食材備料 vs 上菜時限
blocks.en: Analogy: ingredient prep vs. serving deadline

blocks.zh:
想像高級餐廳的廚房：海鮮從處理好到烹調完成送上桌，有嚴格的時間窗口。
                    這不是任意規定，而是基於食品安全數據——細菌在某個溫度下每幾小時翻倍。
                    無菌製程也是同樣邏輯：配製好的藥液、滅菌好的容器，都有其「保鮮窗口」，
                    超過就需要有科學證明它依然安全。
blocks.en: Picture the kitchen of a high-end restaurant: from the moment seafood is prepared to the moment the dish is served, there is a strict time window. This is not arbitrary; it is based on food safety data, since bacteria double every few hours at a given temperature. Aseptic processing follows the same logic: a compounded solution or a sterilized container each has a "freshness window", and beyond it you need scientific proof that it is still safe.

blocks.zh: 過濾時間限制：兩個層面的保護
blocks.en: Filtration time limits: protection on two levels

blocks.zh: 過濾時間限制有雙重功能：
blocks.en: Filtration time limits serve a dual function:

blocks.zh: 防止微生物穿透 (filter penetration)：長時間過濾下， 濾膜上積累的微生物可能因為壓力、生長等原因穿透至下游，破壞無菌性。
blocks.en: Preventing microbial penetration (filter penetration): over a long filtration, microorganisms accumulating on the membrane may grow through or be forced through to the downstream side under pressure, compromising sterility.

blocks.zh: 控制上游生物負荷與內毒素：即使是用於澄清或除粒子的預過濾器， 其表面也是微生物附著的基質，需要限制使用時間，防止內毒素在膜上累積並在壓力下釋放。
blocks.en: Controlling upstream bioburden and endotoxin: even a prefilter used for clarification or particle removal provides a surface for microorganisms to attach to, so its use time must be limited to prevent endotoxin from accumulating on the membrane and being released under pressure.

blocks.zh: 這說明即使是「非滅菌級」的上游過濾器，也需要時間使用限制，且需書面合理化說明。
blocks.en: This shows that even an upstream filter that is not sterilizing-grade needs a time limit on use, with a written justification.

blocks.zh: CDMO/COO 操作應用
blocks.en: CDMO/COO Operational Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 技術轉移過程中，建立時間限制是確效計畫的一部分， 需在工藝特性研究 (process characterization) 階段，設計並執行保留時間研究 (hold time study)。 典型的研究設計是：在最差條件下（最高配製溫度、最長預計保留時間）取樣， 監測生物負荷與內毒素，以科學數據支撐最終 SOP 中的時間限制數值。 沒有支持數據的時間限制，是 FDA 483 觀察項目的常見來源。
blocks.en: During CDMO technology transfer, establishing time limits is part of the validation plan. In the process characterization phase, a hold time study must be designed and executed. A typical design samples under worst-case conditions (highest compounding temperature, longest anticipated hold time) and monitors bioburden and endotoxin, so that scientific data support the time limits in the final SOP. Time limits without supporting data are a frequent source of FDA 483 observations.

blocks.zh: Section IX — Validation Overview 確效總覽 (p. 21)
blocks.en: Section IX — Validation Overview (p. 21)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：確效的完整框架
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Complete Validation Framework

blocks.zh: Section IX 的確效體系涵蓋三大支柱，分別對應無菌製程的三個關鍵環節：
blocks.en: The validation system in Section IX rests on three pillars, each corresponding to a key link in the aseptic process:

blocks.zh: A. 製程模擬 (Process Simulations / Media Fill)：驗證無菌填充操作本身
blocks.en: A. Process simulations (media fill): validates the aseptic filling operation itself

blocks.zh: B. 過濾效能確效 (Filtration Efficacy)：驗證過濾滅菌的有效性
blocks.en: B. Filtration efficacy: validates the effectiveness of sterilizing filtration

blocks.zh: C. 設備/容器/塞子滅菌確效：驗證所有與產品接觸元件的無菌性
blocks.en: C. Sterilization of equipment, containers, and closures: validates the sterility of every product-contact component

blocks.zh:
這三個支柱缺一不可，因為「連鎖破口」理論告訴我們：即使每個元件都分別通過了
                    最嚴格的滅菌，一旦組合過程中發生污染，整個無菌保證體系就失效了。
blocks.en: None of the three pillars can be omitted, because of the "chain of failure" principle: even if every component has individually passed the most rigorous sterilization, contamination during assembly or combination defeats the whole sterility assurance system.

blocks.zh: 注意：變更控制是確效的延伸，不是例外
blocks.en: Note: change control is an extension of validation, not an exception

blocks.zh: 許多廠商誤以為確效是「做一次就夠」的事。FDA 明確指出：設施、設備、製程、 測試方法的任何變更，都必須透過書面變更控制系統評估是否需要 再確效 (revalidation) 或再資格確認 (requalification)。 這意味著確效計畫是「活的文件」，需要持續維護和響應變更。
blocks.en: Many firms mistakenly think validation is a one-time exercise. FDA states clearly that any change to the facility, equipment, process, or test methods must be evaluated through a written change control system to determine whether revalidation or requalification is needed. This means the validation program is a "living document" that must be continually maintained and respond to change.

blocks.zh:
對 CDMO 而言，每次接受新委託方的技術轉移，或者原有產品更換設備/廠房，
                    都構成需要評估再確效的觸發事件。建立完善的觸發事件清單 (trigger list) 並納入
                    變更控制 SOP，可以有效降低因「沒有意識到需要再確效」而在 FDA 查廠時
                    被出具 483 觀察項目的風險。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, every technology transfer from a new client, and every change of equipment or facility for an existing product, is a trigger event that requires a revalidation assessment. Building a thorough trigger list into the change control SOP effectively reduces the risk of receiving an FDA 483 observation because the firm "did not realize revalidation was needed".

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.1 — Process Simulations: Study Design 製程模擬：研究設計 (pp. 21–22)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.1 — Process Simulations: Study Design (pp. 21–22)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：Media Fill 的設計哲學
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Design Philosophy of Media Fill

blocks.zh: 培養基模擬填充 (Media Fill) 的根本邏輯是：用微生物培養基取代真正的藥品， 「假裝」走一遍完整的無菌填充流程。如果任何步驟引入了污染，培養基就會長菌， 提供明確的可偵測訊號。
blocks.en: The fundamental logic of a media fill is to replace the actual drug product with microbiological growth medium and "pretend" to run through the complete aseptic filling process. If any step introduces contamination, the medium grows microorganisms, giving a clear, detectable signal.

blocks.zh: 關鍵設計原則是「最差情境 (worst-case)」——Media Fill 不是要讓程序看起來很完美，而是要刻意納入所有高風險活動， 以確認即使在最具挑戰性的條件下，無菌保證仍能維持。
blocks.en: The key design principle is "worst case". A media fill is not meant to make the process look perfect; it deliberately includes all high-risk activities to confirm that sterility assurance holds even under the most challenging conditions.

blocks.zh: 類比：消防演習不應選最好的天氣
blocks.en: Analogy: a fire drill should not pick the best weather

blocks.zh:
消防演習若只在白天、好天氣、全員在場時舉行，就無法真實反映深夜緊急事故的應對能力。
                    同理，Media Fill 如果只在環境最好、人員最少、操作最簡單的條件下進行，
                    就失去了驗證意義。FDA 要求納入「最差操作條件」，正是要確保演習的有效性。
blocks.en: If a fire drill is held only in daylight, in good weather, with everyone present, it cannot show how well people would respond to a late-night emergency. Likewise, a media fill run under the best environment, with the fewest personnel and the simplest operations, loses its validation value. FDA's requirement to include "worst-case operating conditions" is there to keep the drill meaningful.

blocks.zh: 注意：13 項設計要素——每一項都是稽核重點
blocks.en: Note: 13 design elements, and each one is an audit focus

blocks.zh:
FDA 列出的 13 項 Media Fill 設計要素，是查廠時的逐項核查清單。
                    常見缺失包括：
blocks.en: The 13 media fill design elements listed by FDA serve as an item-by-item checklist during inspections. Common deficiencies include:

blocks.zh: 換班/休息沒有模擬 → 只做單班，漏掉換班污染風險
blocks.en: Shift changes/breaks not simulated, so only a single shift is run and the contamination risk at shift change is missed

blocks.zh: 非例行性干預沒有納入 → 設備調整、維修未模擬
blocks.en: Non-routine interventions not included, with equipment adjustments and repairs not simulated

blocks.zh: 冷凍乾燥產品未模擬部分真空抽取步驟
blocks.en: Lyophilized products where the partial vacuum steps are not simulated

blocks.zh: 批次記錄 (batch record) 填寫不完整或流於形式
blocks.en: Incomplete or perfunctory batch records

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，同一條生產線可能服務多個客戶的不同產品， Media Fill 的設計必須能代表所有這些產品的最差操作情境。 實務上建議建立一份最差情境矩陣 (worst-case matrix)， 列出每個品項的特殊操作步驟（如無菌添加、手動充填、容器尺寸差異）， 確保設計一次 Media Fill 能覆蓋多個產品共用的確效需求， 同時不犧牲代表性。這也是在提案階段向客戶展示專業能力的好機會。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, one production line may serve different products for several clients, and the media fill design must represent the worst-case operations of all of them. In practice, it is advisable to build a worst-case matrix listing the special operating steps of each product (such as aseptic additions, manual filling, or differences in container size), so that one media fill design covers the shared validation needs of several products without sacrificing representativeness. This is also a good opportunity to show the client your expertise at the proposal stage.

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.2 — Frequency and Number of Runs 頻率與執行次數 (pp. 22–23)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.2 — Frequency and Number of Runs (pp. 22–23)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「三次連續成功」的統計意義
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Statistical Meaning of "Three Consecutive Successful Runs"

blocks.zh:
要求三次連續成功，而不是一次，是有統計學依據的：單一成功可能是偶然的好運，
                    而三次連續成功才能建立對製程穩定性 (process consistency) 的信心。
                    反過來說，若三次結果發散（例如一次成功、一次失敗），則更清楚地暴露出製程
                    尚未受控 (out of control)。
blocks.en: Requiring three consecutive successful runs rather than one has a statistical basis: a single success may be good luck, while three consecutive successes build confidence in process consistency. Conversely, if the three results diverge (for example, one success and one failure), it more clearly exposes that the process is not yet in control.

blocks.zh: 注意：觸發額外 Media Fill 的事件清單
blocks.en: Note: Events that trigger additional media fills

blocks.zh: 以下事件可能觸發需要額外 Media Fill 或再確效：
blocks.en: The following events may trigger additional media fills or revalidation:

blocks.zh: 廠房或設備重大修改
blocks.en: Major facility or equipment modifications

blocks.zh: 生產線配置變更
blocks.en: Changes to the line configuration

blocks.zh: 人員重大異動（關鍵操作人員更換）
blocks.en: Significant changes in personnel (replacement of critical operators)

blocks.zh: 環境監控異常趨勢
blocks.en: Adverse trends in environmental monitoring

blocks.zh: 容器/塞子系統變更
blocks.en: Changes to the container/closure system

blocks.zh: 長期停產後復產
blocks.en: Resumption of production after a long shutdown

blocks.zh: 成品無菌測試出現污染結果
blocks.en: Contamination found in a sterility test of the finished product

blocks.zh: 這張清單應納入廠商的變更控制觸發事件矩陣，確保不遺漏任何觸發點。
blocks.en: This list should be built into the firm's change control trigger event matrix so that no trigger point is missed.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，「每人每年至少參與一次」的要求意味著需要精心安排 Media Fill 的排程， 確保所有技術員、QC 人員、維修工程師都能在計畫中的 Media Fill 執行期間出現並參與。 若 CDMO 同時服務多條生產線，建議建立人員參與追蹤矩陣， 防止某些人員「過期」而需要臨時安排補做。 這也是 CDMO 在合約談判時，需要向客戶解釋的固定年度稽核成本之一。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the requirement that "each person participates at least once a year" means media fill scheduling must be planned carefully, so that all technicians, QC staff, and maintenance engineers can take part in a scheduled media fill run. If the CDMO operates several lines, it is advisable to build a personnel participation tracking matrix to prevent some individuals from lapsing and needing an ad hoc make-up run. This is also one of the fixed annual audit costs a CDMO needs to explain to clients during contract negotiations.

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.3 — Duration of Runs 執行持續時間 (p. 23)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.3 — Duration of Runs (p. 23)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：持續時間影響哪些風險？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Which Risks Does Duration Affect?

blocks.zh: Media Fill 的持續時間直接影響能否捕捉到「時間依賴性」的污染風險，包括：
blocks.en: The duration of a media fill directly determines whether it can capture "time-dependent" contamination risks, including:

blocks.zh: 操作人員疲勞效應：長時間操作後，操作人員的無菌意識和動作準確性下降
blocks.en: Operator fatigue: after long periods of work, operators' aseptic awareness and precision of movement decline

blocks.zh: 環境狀態劣化：長時間開啟 RABS/Isolator 後，環境微粒或微生物可能累積
blocks.en: Deterioration of the environment: after a RABS/isolator has been open for a long time, particles or microorganisms in the environment may accumulate

blocks.zh: 干預頻率累積：長時間運行，非例行干預（設備調整、堵塞清除等）發生機率增加
blocks.en: Accumulation of interventions: the longer the run, the more likely non-routine interventions (equipment adjustments, jam clearances, etc.) become

blocks.zh: 因此，「全程模擬」雖理想，但需根據製程特性合理設計。手動操作為主的製程 （如手動充填、手工蓋塞）必須做全程模擬，不能縮短。
blocks.en: Therefore, although a full-length simulation is ideal, it should be designed reasonably according to the process characteristics. Processes dominated by manual operations (such as manual filling or manual stoppering) must be simulated for the full duration and cannot be shortened.

blocks.zh: 注意：凍乾 (Lyophilization) Media Fill 的特殊要求
blocks.en: Note: Special requirements for lyophilization media fills

blocks.zh: 凍乾製程的 Media Fill 有兩個關鍵注意點：
blocks.en: A lyophilization media fill has two key points:

blocks.zh: 培養基不能冷凍：低溫會抑制微生物生長，使潛在污染無法被偵測
blocks.en: The medium must not be frozen: low temperatures inhibit microbial growth, so potential contamination would go undetected

blocks.zh: 必須維持有氧狀態：若進行真空抽取步驟，需確保培養基仍處於有氧環境， 否則好氧微生物無法生長，造成假陰性結果
blocks.en: An aerobic condition must be maintained: if a vacuum step is performed, the medium must remain in an aerobic environment, otherwise aerobic organisms cannot grow, giving false negatives

blocks.zh: 實務上通常是模擬凍乾機的裝載過程（開放小瓶在凍乾機內暴露）， 然後恢復大氣壓、塞塞子，而不是真的進行凍乾程序。
blocks.en: In practice, the usual approach is to simulate the loading of the lyophilizer (open vials exposed inside the chamber), then return to atmospheric pressure and stopper the vials, rather than actually running a lyophilization cycle.

blocks.zh:
許多 CDMO 為了節省培養基成本或人力，傾向縮短 Media Fill 持續時間。
                    這在 FDA 查廠時是風險點——當生產批次是 16 小時連續操作，
                    而 Media Fill 只做了 4 小時，FDA 會質疑後 12 小時的風險是否被充分評估。
                    建議在 Media Fill 方案 (protocol) 中明確記錄持續時間的科學依據，
                    包括「如何覆蓋最差情境干預」的論述，而不僅僅是寫一個時間數字。
blocks.en: To save medium cost or labor, many CDMOs tend to shorten the media fill duration. This is a risk point during FDA inspections: when a production batch is a 16-hour continuous operation but the media fill ran for only 4 hours, FDA will question whether the risk in the last 12 hours was adequately evaluated. Document the scientific rationale for the duration in the media fill protocol, including the argument for "how worst-case interventions are covered", rather than simply writing down a number of hours.

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.4 — Size of Runs 模擬規模 (p. 23)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.4 — Size of Runs (p. 23)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：規模影響統計偵測靈敏度
blocks.en: Core Concept: Run Size Affects Statistical Detection Sensitivity

blocks.zh:
Media Fill 的規模直接影響其統計靈敏度。規模越大，
                    能夠偵測到的低水平污染率越低。例如：
blocks.en: The size of a media fill directly affects its statistical sensitivity. The larger the run, the lower the contamination rate it can detect. For example:

blocks.zh: 10,000 支小瓶中出現 1 個陽性 = 0.01% 污染率
blocks.en: 1 positive in 10,000 vials = 0.01% contamination rate

blocks.zh: 1,000 支小瓶中出現 1 個陽性 = 0.1% 污染率
blocks.en: 1 positive in 1,000 vials = 0.1% contamination rate

blocks.zh: 後者的靈敏度低 10 倍。FDA 對隔離器生產線允許較小規模， 是因為其固有的低污染風險使較低的統計靈敏度是可接受的， 但前提是需要科學論證。
blocks.en: The latter is 10 times less sensitive. FDA allows smaller runs for isolator lines because their inherently low contamination risk makes the lower statistical sensitivity acceptable, but this requires scientific justification.

blocks.zh: 多班次生產是 CDMO 常見的商業模式，但 FDA 明確指出多班次批次需要特別考量。 若一批產品橫跨 3 個生產班次，Media Fill 的設計必須涵蓋所有班次的換班時刻， 否則 FDA 會認為換班帶來的污染風險未被評估。這也是為什麼每班次需獨立設計 半年度 Media Fill 的原因之一——確保每個班次的獨特操作習慣和人員行為都被驗證。
blocks.en: Multiple-shift production is a common CDMO business model, but FDA expressly notes that multiple-shift batches need special consideration. If a batch spans 3 production shifts, the media fill design must cover the shift changes of all shifts, otherwise FDA will consider the contamination risk at shift change unevaluated. This is also one of the reasons each shift needs its own semiannual media fill: it ensures that the working habits and personnel behavior unique to each shift are validated.

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.5–6 — Line Speed & Environmental Conditions 線速度與環境條件 (pp. 23–24)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.5–6 — Line Speed & Environmental Conditions (pp. 23–24)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：高速 vs 低速——哪個是最差情境？
blocks.en: Core Concept: High Speed vs. Slow Speed. Which Is the Worst Case?

blocks.zh: 這是一個反直覺的重要觀念：
blocks.en: This is an important and counterintuitive point:

blocks.zh: 高線速 (High Speed) 最差情境：頻繁干預的製程（如頻繁塞子卡住需手動清除）， 高速下干預頻率更高，每次干預都是污染機會，因此高速是最差情境。
blocks.en: High line speed as worst case: for processes with frequent interventions (for example, frequent stopper jams requiring manual clearance), the intervention rate is higher at high speed and each intervention is a contamination opportunity, so high speed is the worst case.

blocks.zh: 低線速 (Slow Speed) 最差情境：產品在無菌區暴露時間長的製程， 低速意味著每支小瓶在填充線上停留時間更長，環境暴露更多。
blocks.en: Slow line speed as worst case: for processes where product is exposed in the aseptic area for a long time, slow speed means each vial stays on the filling line longer, with more environmental exposure.

blocks.zh: 媒體填充方案需要根據製程特性選擇對應的「最差情境」線速，並書面說明選擇理由。
blocks.en: The media fill protocol must choose the line speed that represents the "worst case" for the process characteristics, and document the reason for the choice.

blocks.zh: 注意：「不能讓 Media Fill 看起來比日常生產更乾淨」
blocks.en: Note: "A media fill must not look cleaner than routine production"

blocks.zh:
FDA 明確指出一個常見問題：廠商為了確保 Media Fill 通過，
                    在執行前進行特別清潔、減少人員、加強環境控制等措施，
                    使 Media Fill 環境優於正常生產環境，
                    這導致 Media Fill 結果無法真實反映商業生產的污染風險。
blocks.en: FDA points to a common problem: to make sure a media fill passes, firms carry out special cleaning, reduce personnel, or strengthen environmental controls beforehand, so that the media fill environment is better than normal production. As a result, the media fill results cannot truly reflect the contamination risk of commercial production.

blocks.zh: 正確做法是：Media Fill 的環境條件應等同於正常商業生產的條件， 包括人員數量、活動水平、設備狀態。但不包括刻意惡化環境（如關閉部分 HVAC）， 那屬於人工創造最差情境，不合理。
blocks.en: The correct approach is that media fill environmental conditions should be equivalent to normal commercial production, including number of personnel, activity level, and equipment status. This does not include deliberately worsening the environment (such as shutting down part of the HVAC), which would be artificially creating a worst case and is not reasonable.

blocks.zh:
CDMO 常有客戶要求「在 Media Fill 執行日加強清潔」，
                    以確保結果漂亮。這是需要婉拒並解釋的請求——FDA 明確反對此做法，
                    而且若 FDA 發現 Media Fill 日的環境監控數據明顯優於日常生產日，
                    會直接質疑 Media Fill 的代表性，甚至要求重做。
                    保持 Media Fill 日與正常生產日一致的環境條件，
                    才是保護雙方的正確做法。
blocks.en: CDMO clients sometimes ask for "extra cleaning on the media fill day" to make sure the result looks good. This request must be declined and explained: FDA expressly opposes the practice, and if FDA finds that environmental monitoring data on the media fill day are clearly better than on routine production days, it will question the representativeness of the media fill and may even require it to be repeated. Keeping environmental conditions on the media fill day the same as on normal production days is the right approach to protect both parties.

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.7 — Media 培養基選擇 (pp. 24–25)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.7 — Media (pp. 24–25)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：培養基選擇的科學依據
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Scientific Basis for Medium Selection

blocks.zh: 大豆酪蛋白消化培養基 (Soybean Casein Digest Medium, SCDM)， 又稱 Tryptic Soy Broth (TSB)，是 FDA 首選，因為它能促進廣泛微生物生長：
blocks.en: Soybean Casein Digest Medium (SCDM), also known as Tryptic Soy Broth (TSB), is FDA's first choice because it supports growth of a broad range of microorganisms:

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陽性菌（如 Staphylococcus aureus）
blocks.en: Gram-positive bacteria (e.g., Staphylococcus aureus)

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陰性菌（如 Escherichia coli）
blocks.en: Gram-negative bacteria (e.g., Escherichia coli)

blocks.zh: 酵母菌（如 Candida albicans）
blocks.en: Yeasts (e.g., Candida albicans)

blocks.zh: 黴菌（如 Aspergillus brasiliensis）
blocks.en: Molds (e.g., Aspergillus brasiliensis)

blocks.zh:
厭氧培養基（Fluid Thioglycollate Medium, FTM）只在特殊情況（如厭氧製程、
                    使用橡膠零件較多的複雜容器）時才需額外考慮。
blocks.en: Anaerobic medium (Fluid Thioglycollate Medium, FTM) needs to be considered only in special cases (such as anaerobic processes or complex containers with many rubber parts).

blocks.zh: 注意：生長促進試驗 (Growth Promotion Test) 是 Media Fill 的品質把關
blocks.en: Note: The growth promotion test is the quality gate of a media fill

blocks.zh:
FDA 要求每批 Media Fill 培養基都需通過生長促進試驗，使用 <100 CFU 的低濃度挑戰，
                    確認培養基確實能促進微生物生長。這樣才能確保：
blocks.en: FDA requires that every batch of media fill medium pass a growth promotion test using a low-level challenge of <100 CFU, to confirm that the medium really does support microbial growth. This ensures that:

blocks.zh: 陰性結果（無菌長出）是真正的無污染，而非培養基失效
blocks.en: A negative result (no growth) means there was truly no contamination, rather than that the medium failed

blocks.zh:
如果生長促進試驗失敗，即使 Media Fill 結果看似無污染，
                        也無法作為製程受控的佐證，需要重做
blocks.en: If the growth promotion test fails, even a media fill that appears free of contamination cannot be used as evidence that the process is in control, and the run must be repeated

blocks.zh: 類比：培養基就像「污染偵探的放大鏡」
blocks.en: Analogy: the medium is the "contamination detective's magnifying glass"

blocks.zh:
如果偵探的放大鏡本身有瑕疵（培養基無法促進微生物生長），
                    那麼「沒有發現污染」就不是真的清白，只是工具失效。
                    生長促進試驗就是定期確認「偵探的放大鏡」工作正常的必要步驟。
blocks.en: If the detective's magnifying glass is itself flawed (the medium cannot support microbial growth), then "no contamination found" does not mean a clean bill of health; it only means the tool has failed. The growth promotion test is the necessary step that periodically confirms the "detective's magnifying glass" is working properly.

blocks.zh:
使用培養基代替藥液，最令廠商擔心的是「培養基會不會污染設備、影響下一批生產」。
                    FDA 的答案很明確：只要執行適當的清潔、消毒、必要時滅菌，
                    後續生產不太可能受影響。這說明 Media Fill 後的設備清潔驗證 (cleaning validation)
                    也是不可缺少的環節——若清潔 SOP 已被確效，則無需額外擔心。
                    這提醒 CDMO 確保 Media Fill SOP 與 Cleaning Validation 程序的無縫銜接。
blocks.en: When medium is used in place of drug product, what worries firms most is whether the medium will contaminate the equipment and affect the next batch. FDA's answer is clear: as long as appropriate cleaning, disinfection, and, where necessary, sterilization are performed, subsequent production is unlikely to be affected. This shows that cleaning validation of the equipment after a media fill is also an indispensable step; if the cleaning SOP has been validated, there is no need for additional concern. This reminds CDMOs to make sure the media fill SOP and the cleaning validation procedure connect seamlessly.

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.8 — Incubation and Examination 培養與檢查 (pp. 25–26)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.8 — Incubation and Examination (pp. 25–26)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：干預單位的處理——一個法規灰色地帶
blocks.en: Core Concept: Handling of Units Removed After Interventions, a Regulatory Gray Area

blocks.zh: 「干預移除的單位是否需要培養」是 Media Fill 管理的重要細節：
blocks.en: Whether units removed after an intervention need to be incubated is an important detail of media fill management:

blocks.zh: 不需要培養的條件：書面 SOP 明確規定了干預後需移除的單位數量， 且批次記錄確認了遵守情況。
blocks.en: Conditions where incubation is not required: a written SOP specifies the number of units to be removed after an intervention, and the batch record confirms compliance.

blocks.zh: 必須培養的情況：SOP 缺乏具體說明，或移除數量超出 SOP 規定。
blocks.en: Cases where incubation is required: the SOP lacks specific instructions, or the number removed exceeds what the SOP specifies.

blocks.zh: 嚴格限制：Media Fill 中干預移除的單位數， 不能超過實際生產批次中移除的數量。
blocks.en: Strict limit: the number of units removed after interventions in a media fill must not exceed the number that would be removed in an actual production batch.

blocks.zh: FDA 擔心的是：廠商透過移除大量「干預單位」來刻意避開潛在的污染單位進入培養計數。
blocks.en: FDA's concern is that firms might remove large numbers of "intervention units" to deliberately keep potentially contaminated units out of the incubation count.

blocks.zh: 注意：培養後發現損壞單位的處理
blocks.en: Note: Handling of damaged units found after incubation

blocks.zh: 培養期間若發現損壞（non-integral）單位，不能直接排除在計數外。 任何排除必須充分說明理由，並在 Media Fill 報告中解釋偏差原因。 若損壞與微生物污染之間存在相關性，必須進行深入調查。 這一要求防止了廠商以「損壞」為由移除疑似陽性單位。
blocks.en: If damaged (non-integral) units are found during incubation, they must not simply be excluded from the count. Any exclusion must be fully justified, and the cause of the deviation explained in the media fill report. If there is a correlation between the damage and microbial contamination, an in-depth investigation is required. This requirement prevents firms from using "damage" as a reason to remove suspected positive units.

blocks.zh:
建立完善的 Media Fill 干預記錄表是 CDMO 的必要工具，
                    記錄每次干預的類型、時間點、移除單位數，並在後續 Media Fill 報告中逐一核對。
                    這不只是 FDA 要求，也是 CDMO 向客戶展示製程受控程度的有力文件。
                    當 FDA 查廠稽核師翻閱 Media Fill 批次記錄時，
                    清晰的干預記錄可以大幅降低進一步質疑的可能性。
blocks.en: A well-designed media fill intervention log is an essential tool for a CDMO. It records the type, timing, and number of units removed for each intervention, and is checked item by item against the media fill report. This is not only an FDA expectation but also a powerful document for showing clients how well the process is under control. When an FDA investigator goes through the media fill batch record, clear intervention records greatly reduce the likelihood of further questions.

blocks.zh: Section IX.A.9 — Interpretation of Test Results 結果判讀 (pp. 26–27)
blocks.en: Section IX.A.9 — Interpretation of Test Results (pp. 26–27)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：「接近零污染」是現代無菌製程的標準
blocks.en: Core Concept: "Near-Zero Contamination" Is the Standard for Modern Aseptic Processing

blocks.zh: FDA 明確指出：現代設計良好的無菌製程設施，其 Media Fill 污染率應接近零。 接受準則中的「允許 1 個污染單位進行調查」，並不是廠商的正常操作目標， 而是監管容忍的最低門檻。
blocks.en: FDA states clearly that for a modern, well-designed aseptic processing facility, the media fill contamination rate should be close to zero. The acceptance criterion that allows "1 contaminated unit to be investigated" is not a normal operating goal for the firm but the minimum threshold of regulatory tolerance.

blocks.zh: 更重要的原則是：即使污染率未達到觸發再確效的門檻， 若反覆出現零星污染，也是製程失控的警示訊號， 需要啟動趨勢調查，而不是依靠「接受準則仍在範圍內」自我安慰。
blocks.en: A more important principle is this: even if the contamination rate has not reached the threshold that triggers revalidation, repeated sporadic contamination is itself a warning sign that the process is out of control, and a trend investigation must be started rather than taking comfort that "the acceptance criteria are still met".

blocks.zh: 注意：Media Fill 無效化 (Invalidation) 必須謹慎
blocks.en: Note: Invalidating a media fill must be done with caution

blocks.zh: FDA 明確表示，Media Fill 無效化應屬罕見事件。 僅在商業批次也需要以同樣方式處理的情況下，才能中止 Media Fill。 這防止了廠商以各種理由「廢掉」不利的 Media Fill 結果而不計入記錄。 任何無效化都需要完整的文件化支持和理由說明。
blocks.en: FDA states that invalidation of a media fill should be a rare event. A media fill may be aborted only in circumstances where a commercial batch would also need to be handled in the same way. This prevents firms from "scrapping" unfavorable media fill results for various reasons without recording them. Any invalidation requires full documented support and justification.

blocks.zh: 類比：Media Fill 接受準則 ≠ 商業批次放行標準
blocks.en: Analogy: media fill acceptance criteria are not commercial batch release criteria

blocks.zh:
Media Fill 允許「有條件接受」1 個污染單位，這並不意味著
                    商業批次出貨時可以含有一個非無菌單位。兩者是完全不同的概念：
                    Media Fill 是製程驗證工具，其接受準則反映的是製程能力評估的統計容忍度；
                    而商業批次必須做到每一支都無菌。
                    FDA 在這裡明確說明了這一重要區別，避免廠商混淆。
blocks.en: The media fill allows "conditional acceptance" of 1 contaminated unit, but this does not mean a commercial batch can be shipped containing one non-sterile unit. The two are entirely different concepts: a media fill is a process validation tool whose acceptance criteria reflect the statistical tolerance of a process capability assessment, whereas a commercial batch must be sterile in every single unit. FDA draws this important distinction explicitly here to avoid confusion among firms.

blocks.zh:
CDMO 對於 Media Fill 陽性結果的調查深度，往往是 FDA 查廠時的重點審查對象。
                    調查報告至少需包含：污染菌的種別鑑定（到種的層級）、
                    可能污染來源的系統性分析（人員、設備、環境、材料）、
                    對前次 Media Fill 以來所有商業批次的影響評估（是否需要啟動商業批次的額外測試或召回評估），
                    以及矯正預防措施 (CAPA) 的具體內容和驗證計畫。
                    不完整的調查報告是 FDA 查廠最常提出的 483 觀察項目之一。
blocks.en: The depth of a CDMO's investigation into a positive media fill is often a focus of FDA inspections. The investigation report should include at least: identification of the contaminating organism to species level, a systematic analysis of possible contamination sources (personnel, equipment, environment, materials), an impact assessment of all commercial batches since the previous media fill (including whether additional testing or a recall assessment of commercial batches is needed), and the specific content and verification plan of the corrective and preventive actions (CAPA). An incomplete investigation report is one of the most frequent 483 observations raised in FDA inspections.

blocks.zh: Media Fill 參數總彙表 Process Simulation Parameter Summary
blocks.en: Process Simulation Parameter Summary

blocks.zh: Section IX.B — Filtration Efficacy 過濾效能確效 (pp. 27–28)
blocks.en: Section IX.B — Filtration Efficacy (pp. 27–28)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何選擇 Brevundimonas diminuta 作為挑戰菌？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Brevundimonas diminuta Chosen as the Challenge Organism?

blocks.zh: Brevundimonas diminuta（舊名 Pseudomonas diminuta，ATCC 19146） 的選擇有其明確的科學邏輯：
blocks.en: The choice of Brevundimonas diminuta (formerly Pseudomonas diminuta, ATCC 19146) has clear scientific logic:

blocks.zh: 尺寸小：平均直徑僅 0.3 µm，比 0.2 µm 濾膜孔徑稍大， 是能被 0.2 µm 濾膜保留的最小常見細菌之一，代表最具挑戰性的穿透風險
blocks.en: Small size: its average diameter is only 0.3 µm, just above the 0.2 µm membrane pore rating, making it one of the smallest common bacteria that a 0.2 µm membrane can retain, and so it represents the most challenging penetration risk

blocks.zh: 生長穩定性：在標準條件下能重複性地生長到均勻尺寸分佈， 確保挑戰的重現性
blocks.en: Growth stability: under standard conditions it grows reproducibly to a uniform size distribution, ensuring the reproducibility of the challenge

blocks.zh: 非病原性：實驗室操作安全
blocks.en: Non-pathogenic: safe to handle in the laboratory

blocks.zh: 挑戰濃度 ≥ 10⁷ 個/cm² 過濾面積的設計，提供了遠超生產中預期生物負荷的安全邊際。
blocks.en: A challenge concentration of ≥ 10⁷ organisms/cm² of filter area provides a safety margin far above the bioburden expected in production.

blocks.zh: 注意：完整性測試 (Integrity Test) 必須在使用後執行
blocks.en: Note: Integrity testing must be performed after use

blocks.zh: 許多廠商只在使用前進行完整性測試（如泡點測試 Bubble Point Test 或前向流測試 Forward Flow Test），卻忽略了使用後測試的重要性。 FDA 明確要求：過濾後必須進行完整性測試，因為使用前測試無法偵測到 在過濾過程中才發生的濾膜損傷（如過濾壓差過大造成的微孔破裂）。 若使用後完整性測試失敗，則該批過濾液的無菌性受到質疑， 需要啟動偏差調查和風險評估。
blocks.en: Many firms perform integrity testing only before use (such as the bubble point test or forward flow test) and overlook the importance of post-use testing. FDA expressly requires integrity testing after filtration, because a pre-use test cannot detect membrane damage that occurs during filtration (such as micropore rupture caused by excessive differential pressure). If the post-use integrity test fails, the sterility of that filtered batch is in question, and a deviation investigation and risk assessment must be started.

blocks.zh: 過濾效能確效往往是 CDMO 接受客戶委託時，最容易被忽視的確效項目。 常見問題包括：使用客戶提供的確效數據，但未確認數據適用於 CDMO 的特定製程條件（如壓力、溫度、濾器批號）； 或使用了與確效研究不同批號/供應商的濾膜。 FDA 明確指出：確效數據必須適用於使用者的特定產品和使用條件， 不同條件下的過濾性能可能顯著不同。 CDMO 需要建立完整的濾膜身份確認 (filter identity verification) 程序， 確保生產用濾膜與確效用濾膜一致（相同聚合物、相同孔徑規格）。
blocks.en: Filtration efficacy validation is often the validation item most easily overlooked when a CDMO takes on a client's project. Common problems include: using validation data supplied by the client without confirming that the data apply to the CDMO's specific process conditions (such as pressure, temperature, and filter lot), or using a membrane from a different lot/supplier than the one used in the validation study. FDA states clearly that validation data must be applicable to the user's specific product and conditions of use, since filtration performance can differ significantly under different conditions. A CDMO needs a thorough filter identity verification procedure to ensure the production filter matches the validated filter (same polymer, same pore size specification).

blocks.zh: Section IX.C — Sterilization of Equipment, Containers, and Closures 設備、容器及塞子滅菌 (pp. 28–30)
blocks.en: Section IX.C — Sterilization of Equipment, Containers, and Closures (pp. 28–30)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SAL 10⁻⁶ 是什麼意思？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Does an SAL of 10⁻⁶ Mean?

blocks.zh: 無菌保證水準 (Sterility Assurance Level, SAL) 10⁻⁶ 意味著： 每 100 萬個滅菌後的物品中，最多允許有一個倖存的微生物。 這是衛生標準中極高的要求，相當於「百萬分之一的不良率」。
blocks.en: A Sterility Assurance Level (SAL) of 10⁻⁶ means that, at most, one surviving microorganism is allowed per 1 million sterilized items. This is an extremely demanding standard, equivalent to a "one in a million failure rate".

blocks.zh: 為達到 SAL 10⁻⁶，滅菌周期的設計必須基於最難被殺滅的位置（冷點）， 確保即使是最難傳熱的位置，也能接收足夠的致死熱量。這也是為何 熱穿透研究 (heat penetration study) 和生物指示劑 (biological indicator) 測試必不可少——單靠溫度傳感器的數據是不夠的。
blocks.en: To achieve an SAL of 10⁻⁶, the sterilization cycle must be designed around the location hardest to sterilize (the cold spot), ensuring that even the position where heat transfer is most difficult receives sufficient lethal heat. This is also why heat penetration studies and biological indicator testing are indispensable: data from temperature sensors alone are not enough.

blocks.zh: 注意：蒸汽中的空氣 (Air) 是致命的確效殺手
blocks.en: Note: Air in steam is a deadly validation killer

blocks.zh: 高壓蒸汽滅菌的工作原理是飽和蒸汽傳遞能量。 空氣是熱的絕緣體，如果高壓釜腔體內殘留空氣， 被空氣包圍的物品（如密閉的套管、折疊的布包）實際溫度可能比腔體溫度低好幾度， 導致表面上看起來達到 121°C，但冷點實際上可能只有 115°C 甚至更低， SAL 目標根本無法達成。 因此排氣步驟（如預真空程序）是蒸汽滅菌周期設計的關鍵， 需要在確效中驗證其有效性。
blocks.en: Autoclave sterilization works by transferring energy through saturated steam. Air is a thermal insulator. If air remains in the chamber, items surrounded by air (such as sealed tubing or folded fabric packs) can be several degrees cooler than the chamber temperature. The reading may appear to reach 121°C, while the cold spot is actually only 115°C or even lower, so the SAL target cannot be achieved at all. Air removal steps (such as a pre-vacuum program) are therefore critical to steam sterilization cycle design, and their effectiveness must be demonstrated in validation.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：SIP 系統的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Core Concept: Special Challenges of SIP Systems

blocks.zh: 就地滅菌 (Sterilize-in-Place, SIP) 系統（如大型配製罐的管路滅菌） 面臨特殊的確效挑戰：管路中安裝的過濾器會在其兩端產生顯著壓差， 導致過濾器下游溫度明顯低於上游。 FDA 建議將生物指示劑放置在過濾器的下游位置， 確保確效數據反映了最難殺滅的位置。
blocks.en: Sterilize-in-place (SIP) systems (such as sterilizing the piping of a large compounding tank) face a particular validation challenge: a filter installed in the line creates a significant pressure drop across it, so the temperature downstream of the filter is clearly lower than upstream. FDA recommends placing biological indicators downstream of the filter to ensure the validation data reflect the location hardest to sterilize.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在滅菌確效方面最常見的稽核問題包括：
blocks.en: The most common audit issues for CDMOs in sterilization validation include:

blocks.zh: 裝載構型變更未再確效：客戶更換了不同尺寸的容器或更改了裝載密度， 但未評估是否需要重新進行熱穿透研究
blocks.en: Load configuration changes without revalidation: the client changes to a different container size or load density, but no assessment is made of whether the heat penetration study must be repeated

blocks.zh: 生物指示劑擺放位置不代表最差情境：習慣性放置於「以前一直放的位置」， 而非根據最新的空腔製圖結果重新評估冷點
blocks.en: Biological indicator placement that does not represent the worst case: they are placed where they have "always been placed", rather than re-evaluating the cold spot against the latest cavity mapping results

blocks.zh: 儀器校正記錄不完整：確效用溫度傳感器在研究前後的校正記錄缺失或過期
blocks.en: Incomplete instrument calibration records: calibration records for the temperature sensors used in validation are missing or out of date before and after the study

blocks.zh: 建立以裝載構型為索引的滅菌確效矩陣， 記錄每種構型的確效狀態、冷點位置和生物指示劑佈置， 是應對查廠的最有效備查工具。
blocks.en: Building a sterilization validation matrix indexed by load configuration, recording the validation status, cold spot location, and biological indicator placement for each configuration, is the most effective reference tool for an inspection.

blocks.zh: Section IX.C.2 — Equipment Controls and Instrument Calibration 設備控制與儀器校正 (pp. 30–31)
blocks.en: Section IX.C.2 — Equipment Controls and Instrument Calibration (pp. 30–31)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：D 值 (D-value) 是什麼？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Is the D-value?

blocks.zh: D 值 (D-value) 是滅菌科學的核心參數：指在特定溫度下， 將微生物群體減少一個 log（即 90% 的微生物被殺滅）所需的時間（分鐘）。
blocks.en: The D-value is a core parameter of sterilization science: the time (in minutes) at a specified temperature needed to reduce a microbial population by one log (that is, to kill 90% of the organisms).

blocks.zh:
例如：D₁₂₁ = 1.5 分鐘意味著在 121°C 下，每 1.5 分鐘微生物數量減少 10 倍。
                    若初始生物負荷為 10⁶，達到 SAL 10⁻⁶ 需要額外殺滅 12 個 log 量級，
                    所需時間 = 12 × D 值。這就是滅菌周期時間計算的科學依據。
blocks.en: For example, D₁₂₁ = 1.5 minutes means that at 121°C the number of microorganisms falls tenfold every 1.5 minutes. If the initial bioburden is 10⁶, reaching an SAL of 10⁻⁶ requires killing a further 12 log orders, so the time needed = 12 × the D-value. This is the scientific basis for calculating the sterilization cycle time.

blocks.zh: 注意：確效用傳感器需在研究前後各校正一次
blocks.en: Note: Validation sensors must be calibrated both before and after the study

blocks.zh: 這是一個常被忽視但 FDA 明確要求的規定：用於確效研究的溫度傳感器， 必須在確效開始前和確效完成後都進行校正。 原因是：如果只有研究前校正，無法排除傳感器在研究過程中發生偏移； 研究後校正可以確認整個確效過程中的溫度數據是可靠的。 若研究後校正發現偏差超過規格，則整個確效結果的有效性都需要重新評估。
blocks.en: This is a frequently overlooked requirement that FDA expressly states: temperature sensors used in validation studies must be calibrated both before the validation begins and after it is completed. If calibration is done only before the study, drift of the sensor during the study cannot be ruled out; the post-study calibration confirms that the temperature data are reliable throughout the validation. If the post-study calibration shows a deviation beyond specification, the validity of the entire validation result must be re-evaluated.

blocks.zh: 類比：「均衡時間 (Equilibrium/Come Up Time)」就像烤箱預熱
blocks.en: Analogy: "equilibration time (come-up time)" is like preheating an oven

blocks.zh: 當你把麵糰放入烤箱，不是一插上電源就開始計時——你要等到烤箱 真正達到設定溫度並穩定後，才開始計算烘烤時間。 高壓蒸汽滅菌的「均衡時間 (come up time)」是同樣概念： 蒸汽進入腔體後，需要一段時間才能使腔體內所有位置的溫度均勻達到目標值， 這段「爬升穩定時間」必須不計入有效殺菌時間內。 若均衡時間異常延長，通常代表設備老化、閥門問題或其他需要調查的工程異常。
blocks.en: When you put dough in the oven, you do not start timing the moment you plug it in; you wait until the oven has actually reached the set temperature and stabilized before counting the baking time. The "come-up time" in autoclave sterilization is the same concept: after steam enters the chamber, it takes a period of time for the temperature at every location in the chamber to reach the target uniformly, and this "ramp-up and stabilization time" must not be counted in the effective sterilization time. If the come-up time is abnormally prolonged, it usually indicates aging equipment, valve problems, or other engineering anomalies that require investigation.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，維護滅菌儀器校正系統（溫度、壓力、時間、皮帶速度） 是 FDA 查廠時的標準審查項目。建議建立儀器校正主計畫 (Instrument Calibration Master Plan)， 並確保所有確效用儀器都有獨立的、高於生產用儀器標準的校正頻率。 此外，若客戶提供了特殊的生物指示劑（自行製備或非商業來源）， 必須確保其 D 值已透過適當的資格確認程序驗證， 不能直接以供應商 CoA 作為替代，除非已完成供應商確認計畫。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, maintaining the calibration system for sterilization instruments (temperature, pressure, time, belt speed) is a standard item in FDA inspections. It is advisable to establish an Instrument Calibration Master Plan and make sure all validation instruments have an independent calibration frequency at a higher standard than production instruments. In addition, if a client supplies special biological indicators (self-prepared or from a non-commercial source), make sure their D-value has been verified through an appropriate qualification procedure; the supplier CoA cannot be used as a substitute unless a supplier qualification program has been completed.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 時間限制 (Section VIII)：每個無菌製程階段（配製→過濾→填充→儲存）均需以生物負荷和內毒素數據支持有時間限制；偏差需文件化並科學論證不影響品質；過濾時間限制需同時保護免於微生物穿透及上游污染物累積。
blocks.en: Time limits (Section VIII): every aseptic process stage (compounding → filtration → filling → storage) needs time limits supported by bioburden and endotoxin data; deviations must be documented and scientifically justified as not affecting quality; filtration time limits must protect against both microbial penetration and accumulation of upstream contaminants.

blocks.zh: 製程模擬設計 (IX.A.1)：Media Fill 須納入 13 項設計要素，以最差情境為核心，包括最長班次、全類型干預、換班、維修活動，並準備完整批次記錄；不得用 Media Fill 來合理化高風險做法。
blocks.en: Process simulation design (IX.A.1): a media fill must include the 13 design elements, with worst case as the core, including the longest shift, all types of interventions, shift changes, and maintenance activities, and with complete batch records prepared; a media fill must not be used to justify high-risk practices.

blocks.zh: 頻率與次數 (IX.A.2)：初始確效需 3 次連續成功；例行確效每條線每半年；所有授權人員每年至少參與一次；重大變更或失敗後需評估並可能觸發額外 Media Fill 或再確效。
blocks.en: Frequency and number of runs (IX.A.2): initial validation requires 3 consecutive successful runs; routine revalidation is semiannual for each line; all authorized personnel must participate at least once a year; major changes or failures require evaluation and may trigger additional media fills or revalidation.

blocks.zh: 持續時間與規模 (IX.A.3–4)：手動製程需全程模擬；規模起始點 5,000–10,000 支；手動密集型需接近完整批量；隔離器可較小；凍乾培養基不可冷凍且需維持有氧狀態。
blocks.en: Duration and size (IX.A.3–4): manual processes need full-duration simulation; the starting run size is 5,000–10,000 units; manually intensive operations need close to the full batch size; isolators may use smaller runs; lyophilization media must not be frozen and must remain aerobic.

blocks.zh: 線速、環境與培養基 (IX.A.5–7)：每次 Media Fill 測試單一線速並書面合理化；環境條件須等同正常生產（不得美化）；培養基首選 TSB/SCDM，需 <100 CFU 生長促進試驗；填充量需能接觸容器壁並可目視觀察。
blocks.en: Line speed, environment, and media (IX.A.5–7): test a single line speed in each media fill and justify it in writing; environmental conditions must be equivalent to normal production (no embellishment); the preferred medium is TSB/SCDM, with a growth promotion test at <100 CFU; the fill volume must contact the container walls and allow visual observation.

blocks.zh: 培養與判讀 (IX.A.8–9)：培養 20–35°C、±2.5°C 控制、最少 14 天（雙溫各 7 天）；目標零污染；<5K 支 1 個即再確效；5K–10K 支 1 個需調查、2 個再確效；污染菌需鑑定到種的層級；需評估對商業批次的影響。
blocks.en: Incubation and interpretation (IX.A.8–9): incubate at 20–35°C, controlled within ±2.5°C, for at least 14 days (7 days at each of two temperatures); the goal is zero contamination; <5K units: 1 contaminated unit means revalidation; 5K–10K units: 1 requires investigation and 2 mean revalidation; contaminating organisms must be identified to species level; the impact on commercial batches must be assessed.

blocks.zh: 過濾效能確效 (IX.B)：0.2 µm 滅菌級濾膜需以 B. diminuta ATCC 19146（≥10⁷/cm²）進行微生物挑戰；直接接種配方為首選；使用後必須進行完整性測試（泡點/前向流）；確效數據需適用於使用者的特定產品和條件。
blocks.en: Filtration efficacy validation (IX.B): a 0.2 µm sterilizing-grade membrane requires a microbiological challenge with B. diminuta ATCC 19146 (≥10⁷/cm²); direct inoculation of the formulation is preferred; integrity testing (bubble point/forward flow) must be performed after use; validation data must apply to the user's specific product and conditions.

blocks.zh: 滅菌確效 (IX.C)：設備需每批次滅菌；確效需涵蓋空腔研究→熱穿透研究→生物指示劑挑戰三層次；達到 SAL 10⁻⁶；蒸汽滅菌需排除空氣；儀器需在確效前後均校正；D 值確認是生物指示劑使用的前提。
blocks.en: Sterilization validation (IX.C): equipment must be sterilized for every batch; validation must cover three layers, namely the cavity study, the heat penetration study, and the biological indicator challenge; an SAL of 10⁻⁶ must be achieved; steam sterilization must remove air; instruments must be calibrated both before and after validation; confirmation of the D-value is a prerequisite for using biological indicators.

blocks.zh: CDMO 核心風險點：時間限制無數據支持、Media Fill 環境條件美化、培養時間縮短、干預單位處理不當、過濾器身份確認缺失、滅菌裝載變更未再確效、確效儀器校正記錄不完整，均為 FDA 查廠常見 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: Core CDMO risk points: time limits without supporting data, embellished media fill environmental conditions, shortened incubation time, improper handling of intervention units, missing filter identity verification, sterilization load changes without revalidation, and incomplete calibration records for validation instruments are all common FDA 483 observations.
